nodes.description: Constant holding the number of seconds in a day (86400), used for day-based rounding.
Immutable IERC20 token held by the timelock contract.
Immutable beneficiary address that receives released tokens.
Immutable timestamp marking the start of the token release period.
Timestamp marking the end of the release period; can be rewritten by terminate().
Total balance of benefit allocated to the beneficiary; reduced by terminate().
Accumulated amount already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating whether the contract has been terminated by the owner.
Initializes token, beneficiary, release window and total benefit; validates release end against block.timestamp.
View computing the currently released amount based on block.timestamp, start and end times.
View returning _totalBenefit minus releasedBalance().
Public function transferring released-but-unwithdrawn tokens to the beneficiary.
Owner-only function that terminates the contract and sweeps unreleased tokens to the owner.
Getter returning the held token.
Getter returning the beneficiary address.
Getter returning the total benefit.
Getter returning the already withdrawn balance.
Modifier requiring that the contract has not been terminated.
Caller-controlled address, used by the onlyOwner check in terminate().
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp driving release calculations and termination.
External ERC20 safeTransfer of the released amount to the beneficiary inside withdraw().
External ERC20 safeTransfer of the unreleased remainder to the owner inside terminate().
Arithmetic state update _withdrawedBalance += amount in withdraw().
Arithmetic modification releaseStartTime_ -= (releaseStartTime_ % SECONDS_OF_A_DAY) in the constructor.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is assigned to state variable _releaseStartTime.
releaseStartTime_ is modified by subtraction and modulo arithmetic in the constructor.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ is used to compute _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned to state variable _totalBenefit.
Constructor enforces require(_releaseEndTime > block.timestamp), a timestamp dependency.
Constructor uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY for start-time rounding.
Constructor executes the arithmetic rounding of releaseStartTime_.
releasedBalance() branches on block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
releasedBalance() reads _releaseStartTime.
releasedBalance() reads _releaseEndTime.
releasedBalance() reads _totalBenefit.
releasedBalance() computes local passedDays.
releasedBalance() computes local totalDays.
unreleasedBalance() calls releasedBalance().
unreleasedBalance() reads _totalBenefit.
withdraw() calls releasedBalance() to determine the releasable amount.
withdraw() reads and updates _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() computes local amount as releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance.
Local amount flows into the _withdrawedBalance increment operation.
Arithmetic update writes the new value into state variable _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() performs an external token transfer that can hand control to an untrusted token contract.
Local amount is passed as the value argument of the external safeTransfer call.
The external transfer sends tokens to the _beneficiary address.
withdraw() reads the _token state variable to perform the transfer.
A malicious ERC20 implementation can reenter withdraw() from the transfer callback.
terminate() is guarded by the isNotTerminated modifier.
terminate() is restricted by onlyOwner, which compares owner() with msg.sender.
terminate() calls releasedBalance() to recompute _totalBenefit.
terminate() overwrites _totalBenefit with the released balance.
terminate() overwrites _releaseEndTime with the current day.
terminate() derives _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
terminate() computes local amountToWithdraw from the token balance and benefit.
Local amountToWithdraw is passed as the value argument of the external safeTransfer call.
terminate() performs an external token transfer to the owner.
terminate() sets the _isTerminated flag to true.
terminate() reads the _token state variable to perform the sweep transfer.
A malicious ERC20 implementation can reenter terminate() from the transfer callback.
isNotTerminated modifier reads the _isTerminated flag.
token() getter returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() getter returns the _beneficiary state variable.
totalBenefit() getter returns the _totalBenefit state variable.
withdrawedBalance() getter returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
